The Ogun State Police Command says it has detained the driver of an Iveco truck after it allegedly knocked down and killed a Vehicle Inspection Officer, Oluwaseun Adeshina, along the Agbara–Unilever Expressway. The fatal incident occurred at about 11.10 am on Monday, November 16, opposite Tipper Garage, Korogboji, in Ogun State. The Police Public Relations Officer, Babaseyi Oluseyi, confirmed the incident in a statement on Tuesday, saying the truck and its driver had been taken to the station for investigation. He noted that the truck reportedly knocked down Adeshina while he was performing his official duties, resulting in fatal injuries. Oluseyi stated, “The Ogun State Police Command confirms a fatal road accident involving an Iveco truck and a VIO official, Oluwaseun Adeshina, at about 11:10 a.m. on Monday, 16 November 2026, opposite Tipper Garage, Korogboji, along the Agbara–Unilever Expressway. The area remains calm,” he concluded. This is not the first time a traffic official has been knocked down dead in the line of duty. PUNCH Metro reported in December 2012 that a mob nabbed a truck driver and handed him over to the police after he reportedly crushed an official of the Federal Road Safety Corps to death and injured another on the Sagamu-Ijebu Ode Road, Ogun State. The mob consisted of motorists and motorcycle riders who witnessed the accident.
